policies.title: Spending approval threshold
policies.text: Any purchase with a total above PKR 50,000 must be approved through the approval process before an order is placed. Purchases of exactly PKR 50,000 or less do not need approval.

policies.text: Suppliers on the restricted supplier list (Neelum Cleaning Supplies) are under compliance review. Every order from a restricted supplier must be approved through the approval process, whatever the amount.
